articles.title: Trump's crypto riches loom over Clarity Act talks to ban conflicts for U.S. officials
articles.snippet: Discussion among Democrats have fixed on the president's personal gains when hashing out the crypto market structure bill's ethics provision.

articles.title: Donald Trump invokes US senator’s death to push crypto bill
articles.snippet: With the death of Senator Lindsey Graham and another senator hospitalized, Republicans’ current majority in the chamber has been reduced to 51-47, likely requiring more Democratic support to pass crypto market structure.

articles.title: Bitcoin threatens $62K in risk-asset rout as Donald Trump says US will 'run' closed Hormuz Strait
articles.snippet: Bitcoin bulls faced an uphill struggle to preserve $62,000 as stocks opened down on Strait of Hormuz rhetoric between the US and Iran.

articles.title: Robinhood L2 sparks ETH optimism, Saylor 'muddies waters.' Hodler's Digest, July 5-12, 2026
articles.snippet: Even Ethereum's critics say Robinhood Chain is bullish for ETH. Nigel Farage and US President Donald Trump become embroiled in crypto related scandals, and more.

articles.title: Democrats Call for Senate Hearings on Trump's Massive Crypto Profits
articles.snippet: Top Democrats on key Senate committees demanded inquiries into the more than $1.2 billion that President Trump made on crypto last year.
